collection.title: Metal Frame High Chairs
collection.body_html:
Metal Frame High Chairs

Metal frame high chairs offer superior durability and stability for everyday feeding. Constructed with steel or aluminum frames, these high chairs provide a sturdy foundation that withstands years of use while maintaining structural integrity.

The metal construction allows for easy cleaning and maintenance, with frames that resist stains, odors, and wear. Many models feature powder-coated finishes that protect against rust and scratches while complementing modern kitchen aesthetics.

Key features include adjustable height settings, removable trays, and safety harness systems. The metal frame design supports higher weight capacities compared to plastic alternatives, accommodating children from infancy through toddler years. Compact folding mechanisms on select models enable convenient storage when not in use.

These high chairs combine industrial strength with practical functionality, making them ideal for busy households and commercial settings. The non-porous metal surfaces resist bacteria buildup and simplify sanitation between meals.

Adjustable Baby High Chair with Foldable Design

The KonaTot High-Legged Feeding Chair provides a safe and comfortable mealtime solution from first solids through toddler years. This foldable high chair features adjustable height positions, a secure 5-point harness, and a removable dishwasher-safe tray for easy cleanup.

Key Features

Foldable & Portable Design - Compact storage for small spaces and easy transport to family visits or restaurants.

Adjustable Height & Recline - Multiple positions adapt as your child grows from 3 to 36 months, suitable for feeding, play, or rest.

5-Point Safety Harness - Secure restraint system keeps your baby safely seated during meals.

Removable Dishwasher-Safe Tray - Easy-clean tray removes quickly for convenient post-meal cleanup.

High-Legged Stability - Elevated design brings baby to table height for family meals while maintaining secure stability.

Cushioned Wipeable Seat - Comfortable padding with easy-clean surface for quick maintenance.

Product Specifications

  • Age Range: 3 to 36 months
  • Weight Capacity: Up to 40 lbs (18 kg)

Setup: Unfold chair legs and lock into place. Adjust height and recline for your child's age.

  • Contemporary color options suit any kitchen, patio, or picnic setup
